screening_decisions.reason: Randomized controlled trial comparing thermoradiotherapy vs radiotherapy alone in rectal cancer. States 'Patients were selected on the principle of randomization' with control group. Appears to be phase II design based on sample size (56+59 patients) and exploratory nature.
Multi-institutional observational study, not a randomized controlled trial. No randomization mentioned; describes accumulated results from different institutions treating various tumor types.
Prospective randomized study comparing VHF+RT vs RT alone in rectal cancer. 75 patients randomized (37 to RT, 36 to VHF+RT). Meets criteria for randomized controlled trial, likely phase II/III.

Prospective, randomised, multicentre trial with 358 patients. Clearly states randomization and compares radiotherapy alone vs radiotherapy plus hyperthermia. Phase III design based on sample size and multicentre nature.
Randomized trial with 122 patients randomly treated with three different methods (hyperthermia+RT, RT alone, surgery alone). Meets criteria for randomized controlled trial, likely phase II.
Abstract does not mention randomization. Describes comparison of different treatment approaches but no indication of randomized design. Cannot confirm RCT status.
Explicitly states 'Phase III study' and 'prospectively controlled randomized study'. 184 patients randomized to IRT vs ITRT. Meets all inclusion criteria.
Review article summarizing literature and clinical data, not a primary randomized controlled trial. States 'The literature and own clinical data are reviewed'.
Observational study comparing patients with and without hyperthermia. No randomization mentioned. 102 patients analyzed, 46 received hyperthermia - appears to be non-randomized comparison.
Abstract states patients were 'divided into two groups' but does not mention randomization. 41 patients divided into Group A (20) and Group B (21) - no indication of randomized allocation.
Abstract describes analysis of results from 112 patients with thermoradiotherapy and 91 control patients. No mention of randomization. Appears to be retrospective or observational comparison.

Secondary analysis of data from a phase III trial, focusing on adjuvant chemotherapy outcomes. Not a primary randomized trial of hyperthermia vs control - rather a post-hoc analysis of chemotherapy administration.
Non-randomized comparison. Group I (35 tumors) received RT+hyperthermia, Group II (36 tumors) were 'unsuitable for hyperthermia' - allocation based on clinical suitability, not randomization.
Explicitly states 'A Phase I study' - does not meet phase II/III criteria. Single-arm study of 353 patients with advanced tumors.
Summary article describing results from 1211 patients. No mention of randomization or controlled trial design. Appears to be retrospective analysis.

Observational comparison of patients treated with vs without hyperthermia. No randomization mentioned. 137 patients treated, 69 with hyperthermia, 68 without - allocation method not specified as randomized.
Case series of 26 patients treated with combined therapy. No control group, no randomization. Descriptive study of treatment outcomes.
Prospective observational study examining circumferential margin involvement. No randomization, no intervention comparison. 190 patients examined for margin status.
Study of head and neck cancer (not rectal cancer). Observational study of tumor oxygenation. No randomization, 63 patients underwent oxygen assessment.
Retrospective study of 167 consecutive patients. No randomization, no intervention. Examines prognostic factors in rectal cancer specimens.
Meta-analysis/systematic overview of 22 randomized trials. Not a primary randomized trial itself. Analyzes data from 8,507 patients across multiple studies.
Randomized trial but does not involve hyperthermia. Compares preoperative radiation vs no radiation in rectal cancer. Does not meet the review's focus on hyperthermia.
Randomized trial (NSABP R-01) but does not involve hyperthermia. Compares surgery alone vs chemotherapy vs radiation. No hyperthermia component.
Randomized trial comparing radiotherapy vs chemoradiotherapy. No hyperthermia component. 733 patients randomized.
Observational study comparing operative vs non-operative treatment based on clinical response. No randomization - patients allocated based on response to chemoradiation.
Case series of 115 patients. No randomization, no control group. Describes outcomes after total mesorectal excision.
Study of cervical cancer (not rectal cancer). Observational study of tumor oxygenation. No randomization, 103 patients.
Diagnostic accuracy study of transrectal ultrasound. No randomization, no intervention. 55 patients prospectively studied.
Secondary analysis of a randomized trial examining CRM involvement. Not a primary trial of hyperthermia. No hyperthermia component.
Secondary analysis of quality of life from a randomized trial. No hyperthermia component. Compares short-course radiotherapy vs chemoradiation.
Retrospective study of 412 patients. No randomization, no intervention. Describes patterns of recurrence after surgery.
Randomized trial comparing preoperative vs postoperative radiotherapy. No hyperthermia component. 471 patients randomized.
Retrospective histopathological study of 52 patients. No randomization, no intervention. Examines lateral tumor spread.
Retrospective review of 142 cases. No randomization, no intervention. Describes patterns of recurrence after surgery.
Diagnostic accuracy study of MRI for staging. No randomization, no intervention. 36 patients.
Randomized trial comparing preoperative radiation vs surgery alone. No hyperthermia component. 849 patients randomized.
Review article discussing tumor hypoxia and treatment strategies. Not a primary clinical trial. No patient data.
Randomized study but focuses on macrofractional irradiation, not hyperthermia. Mentions hyperthermia only for anal canal cancer at end. 451 patients randomized to radiation vs control.
Case series of 14 patients. No randomization, no control group. Describes brachytherapy outcomes.
Molecular/biomarker study of 66 patients. Not a randomized trial. Examines gene expression in response to therapy.
Diagnostic accuracy study of MRI. No randomization, no intervention. 76 patients assessed.
Retrospective review of 325 patients. No randomization, no intervention. Examines prognostic factors.
Appears to be review or commentary article. Abstract truncated. No indication of randomized trial design.
Retrospective study of 75 patients who had reoperations. No randomization, no intervention. Examines patterns of failure.
Randomized trial (1861 patients) comparing preoperative radiotherapy+TME vs TME alone. No hyperthermia component.
Randomized trial (204 patients) comparing radiation alone vs radiation+chemotherapy. No hyperthermia component.
